title: KGB department researching unknown flying and underwater objects

tellings.quote: president showed to our leader. Back then, there was a special department of administration within the KGB of the USSR for researching these unknown flying and not just flying, but also underwater objects.

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, described as a former president of a republic within Russia, says that in Soviet times the KGB, the Soviet Union's security and intelligence service, had a special department that researched unknown flying objects and also unknown underwater objects. He ties the claim to Mikhail Gorbachev, the last Soviet leader, though his telling is vague about how. If true, it would mean the Soviet state studied these objects in secret, much as others claim the US did.
